name: Teuchi Udon
description: Teuchi Udon — a handmade udon shop theme laid out like an app: under a formal top header, a pine-ink sidebar holds the synced noodle board (today's flour, hours, seats, wait, closed days and a Reserve a table button) and stays beside the page while it scrolls. The header splits the menu around the centred shop name, with the Reserve a table button at its end. Chitose green (#316745), the deep pine green of traditional Japanese dyeing, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are chitose green fields set in rice-paper white, with wheat-gold labels. The hero is a diagonal split: the title, lead, buttons and today's bowls on the green field, the pencil sketch of the noodle kitchen cut on a slant beside it, and a cut-out bowl of udon (transparent WebP) sitting on the seam and breaking over the hero bottom edge; a cut-out flour sack breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a full pencil-sketch illustration with a soft green and wheat wash. The menu is a card mosaic of four bowls. Kaisei Decol for display, Be Vietnam Pro for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b4-10 (sidebar-app, diagonal-split hero, split nav, full-illustration, pencil-sketch, chitose #316745, Kaisei Decol + Be Vietnam Pro, food-drink). A formal top header with the shop name centred between the menu and the Reserve a table button; the sidebar holds the synced noodle board. Break-frame: the cut-out udon bowl sits on the diagonal seam and breaks over the hero bottom edge, and the cut-out flour sack over the story band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 千歲綠的手打烏龍麵店：側欄今日麵況、斜切分割主視覺、去背麵碗破格而出、鉛筆素描插畫，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A chitose green handmade udon shop: a sidebar noodle board, a diagonal-split hero, a cut-out bowl breaking out and pencil sketches.
summary.ja: 千歳緑の手打ちうどん店。サイドバーの本日の麺、斜めに割れたヒーロー、枠を越える丼の切り抜き、鉛筆スケッチ。
summary.fr: Une échoppe d’udon vert chitose : tableau du jour en barre latérale, hero en diagonale, bol détouré qui déborde, croquis au crayon.
summary.de: Ein Udon-Laden in Chitose-Grün: Nudeltafel in der Seitenleiste, diagonal geteilter Hero, freigestellte Schale, Bleistiftskizzen.
